name: OneLake
short_description: The single, organization-wide logical data lake that comes with Microsoft Fabric; shortcuts let workloads reference data in other locations without importing a duplicate copy.

evidence.quote: One Lake shortcuts can remove some reasons for another physical copy.
every fabric setup comes with a single storage layer called one Lake
One lake is one shared storage spot for the company's data.
One lake removes that one copy
One lake security lets you define access roles on the lake itself
Microsoft describes One Lake as the single place for all of your analytics data
they starting, you know, with a few foundations like one lake where, you know, your entire data assets
One lake is Microsoft's one storage layer for fabric.
one Lake is the one store all of that data lives in.
